aboutH2: Life Science Addiction Treatment Centre: Private Residential Rehab in Rigaud
intro: Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

pillars.title: Mountainside Campus
pillars.body: Located on Quebecs’s Rigaud Mountain is the serene and natural surroundings of Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s Mountainside campus. The center is located within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario. Its secluded mountain location offers the perfect, uninterrupted backdrop for peaceful and successful addiction recovery. The clients staying at the center can relax in private and cozy quarters situated on a floor of the house. The quarters are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and access to necessary amenities like laundry room and cinema room.

pillars.title: Treatment Approach
pillars.body: The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s treatment approach is not just about getting patients off drugs or alcohol. The comprehensive plans prioritize the healing of the whole person- mind, body, and soul. Therefore, the treatment includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational. Their medical team is available 24/7, and once checked into the program, patients receive immediate care to address addiction-related medical issues.

pillars.title: 12 Step Facilitation Program
pillars.body: The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center stresses a 12-Step Introduction as one of the specific components of its program. The 12-step facilitation for addiction treatment is directed toward helping individuals become involved in self-help groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. The center understands the importance of group support in the recovery process and encourages its patients to connect with others who have similar challenges. The program also includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, exercise, leisure, and recreational activities.

overviewH2: Life Science Addiction Treatment: Center Overview
overview: At Life Science Addiction Treatment Center, individuals are welcomed into a supportive and compassionate environment where they can begin their journey towards recovery. The facility’s team of experienced professionals work closely with clients to provide tailored treatment plans that meet their unique needs. Whether short or long-term, the center’s inpatient services are designed to help individuals overcome alcohol and drug addiction in a safe, secure, and comfortable setting.
serviceCaption: 12 services · from the original listing and the centre's public profiles
afterOverview: Through evidence-based practices, clients are taught constructive life skills that can lead to sustained recovery and improved quality of life. The center’s focus on teaching healthy coping mechanisms and effective communication skills helps individuals achieve personal, social, and occupational success. With a commitment to affordable care, Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is dedicated to making high-quality treatment accessible to anyone struggling with addiction.

Life Science runs in one house in Rigaud, and its Psychology Today profile says it has been in business for 15 years. Google lists it as Life Science Addiction Treatment Centre; its French name is Centre de traitement des dépendances Science de la vie. The program itself runs in English. It accepts adults from 18 up, older adults included, and men and women share the same therapy groups.

location.heading: Life Science Addiction Treatment Centre in Rigaud, Quebec
location.intro: The centre is on Rue Kimpton in Rigaud, a town in Vaudreuil-Soulanges on the Ontario border, at the western edge of Montérégie. By the centre's own count downtown Montreal is about 45 minutes away and Ottawa about an hour and a half, while the West Island is roughly half an hour east on Highway 40 and Hudson and Vaudreuil-Dorion are closer still.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its public profiles. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Life Science Addiction Treatment Centre cost?
faqs.a: Life Science does not publish its fees. Recovery.com lists it as a private pay centre with no rates posted, and the centre describes its care as professional and affordable. Call admissions at 450-451-9995 to get the price for the length of stay you need.

faqs.q: How long is the treatment at Life Science Addiction Treatment Center?
faqs.a: Treatment lengths vary depending on the specific needs of each patient. Short-term, moderate stay, or long-term options are available.

faqs.q: How do I get to Life Science from Montreal or Ottawa?
faqs.a: Life Science is at 114 Rue Kimpton in Rigaud, off Highway 40 between Montreal and Ottawa. The centre puts the drive at about 45 minutes from Montreal and 90 minutes from Ottawa, and the West Island, Hudson and Vaudreuil-Dorion are nearer. Call admissions before you leave so they can confirm your arrival time.
The center is located on Québec’s Rigaud Mountain within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario.

faqs.q: Is Life Science a private centre? Can I use insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private residential centre, not a public CISSS or CIUSSS addiction service. Recovery.com lists it as private pay and names no insurers, so ask admissions directly whether your employer plan or private insurance will reimburse part of the stay.

faqs.q: Are mental health issues treated as well?
faqs.a: Yes, Life Science Addiction Treatment Center puts equal emphasis on treating any additional mental health issues that may be present, such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, PTSD, and personality disorders.

faqs.q: Is the treatment center only for English-speaking individuals?
faqs.a: Yes, the center is designed for English-speaking adults and elders.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave Life Science?
faqs.a: The original listing names several aftercare options: family follow-up counselling, in-person follow-up sessions, return visits, a recovery coach and support meetings, some of them on site. The 12-Step introduction during your stay is meant to get you into AA or NA meetings near home, whether that is in Montreal, the Ottawa area or elsewhere. Ask admissions how follow-up is set up when you finish.

faqs.q: Is family involved in the treatment process?
faqs.a: Yes, the facility offers family therapy sessions, which can help establish healthier family dynamics and help support ongoing recovery.

The center uses an integrative approach, including medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational.
It is the direction toward helping individuals become involved in Alcoholics Anonymous or other self-help groups. It stresses the importance of group support in the recovery process.
The center boasts a cinema room, laundry room, private quarters equipped with en-suite bathrooms, and semi-private bedrooms.
